Whenever necessary, you'll also operate a forklift or support your colleagues with other warehouse activities. This combination of tasks ensures plenty of variety throughout your working week. Your main responsibilities include: - Loading, unloading, and transporting pallets and long materials; - Scanning, registering, and storing goods in the correct warehouse locations; - Checking incoming and outgoing products to ensure they meet quality standards; - Helping your colleagues with various other warehouse activities. You'll work Monday to Friday, from 08:00 to 17:00, giving you plenty of free time in the evenings and weekends!
